scenario: [LSTR.3.2] String ordering at runtime, the ASCII case. Three Items with labels "A", "M" and "Z" against `i.label > "M"`: only "Z" is strictly greater, so exactly one message, naming it. A runtime that compared the strings numerically, or as equal, logs "A" or "M" too. It runs in `logical/` so both runtimes read it.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label > "M"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
